### For the Coming Generation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/coming-generation
Passage: Psalm 78:4
Points:
- Believers carry an essential responsibility to pass God's unchanged truth to future generations.
- Sacred history is recounted not merely for factual knowledge, but to transform hearts and foster godliness.
- The failures and ingratitude of the wilderness generation serve as a cautionary warning for the covenant community.
- God sovereignly preserves His remnant through the faithful teaching and discipleship of parents and church leaders.

### Bible Pathway - July 8, 2011
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-july-8-2011.html
Passage: Psalm 78:34-42
Points:
- Despite witnessing God's miraculous deliverance and daily provision, Israel continually fell into discontent and unbelief.
- The people often turned to God only in times of calamity, offering superficial repentance without true heart loyalty.
- Israel's history of rebellion in the wilderness serves as a clear warning against spiritual forgetfulness.
- Believers are called to turn away from self-centeredness and rest fully in God's sufficient grace and promises.
